# Intentionality bias

Intentionality bias is the tendency to attribute events to a will, to see design where there are only causes or chance. Valuable for understanding other people's actions, this tendency misleads when it lends intentions to accidents, crises or epidemics.

**At stake in** : [The value of truth](../axes/truth-value.md)

**See also** : [Confirmation bias](../glossary/confirmation-bias.md) · [Proportionality bias](../glossary/proportionality-bias.md)
